# Drop duplicate patients, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df_clean = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')
print('New shape after deduplication:', trial_df_clean.shape)

# Confirm no duplicates remain
print('Duplicates in patient_id after dedup:', trial_df_clean['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline after dedup:', trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0, -999, -999.00]).sum())

# Impute sentinel values in biomarker_baseline with median
median_baseline = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].median()
trial_df_clean.loc[trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0, -999, -999.00]), 'biomarker_baseline'] = median_baseline

print(f'Imputed {trial_df_clean[trial_df_clean["biomarker_baseline"] == median_baseline].shape[0]} rows with median baseline value: {median_baseline:.2f}')

print('\nResponse rates by arm:')
response_by_arm = trial_df_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()
